title: CAN-X agent task contract
description: One unit of delegated work with a bounded, machine-checkable ownership surface. This file is the interchange contract; tools/agent/contracts.py is the enforcement. A test asserts the two required-field lists never drift.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bumped only for a breaking change.

task_id.description: Deterministic, bounded, human-readable id, e.g. AGENT-02-B.

objective.description: What must be true when the task is done. Frozen once work starts.

non_goals.description: Explicitly out of scope for this task.

base_sha.description: The integration commit the task branched from. Full 40 hex only.

worktree.description: Repository-relative worktree path; must live under worktrees_dir.

owner.description: Agent identity: main, sub-a, sub-b, sub-c, sub-d.

allowed_paths.description: Ownership surface. Anything not listed here is not editable. Globs: *, **, ?.

forbidden_paths.description: Explicit exclusions inside the allowed surface; they win over allowed_paths.

dependencies.description: Task ids that must be DONE before this task is READY.

shared_contracts.description: The shared contracts this task is built against, and the revision it was built against.

required_tests.description: Test names a handoff must report for the task to be integration-ready.

risk_class.description: Development risk label. Never to be confused with the Runtime RiskLevel.

revision.description: Bumped when a frozen field changes; a silent change is refused.
